scripts.ready: pnpm run check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter storybook build && pnpm --filter kitchen-sink build && pnpm --filter @flanksource/clicky-ui test && pnpm --filter storybook test && pnpm --filter e2e test
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md packages/ui/package.json packages/ui/README.md apps/kitchen-sink/package.json apps/storybook/package.json apps/docs/package.json apps/docs/astro.config.mjs apps/docs/scripts/*.mjs apps/docs/src/content.config.ts apps/docs/src/styles/docs.css "apps/docs/src/content/docs/**/*.{md,mdx}" e2e/package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md packages/ui/package.json packages/ui/README.md apps/kitchen-sink/package.json apps/storybook/package.json apps/docs/package.json apps/docs/astro.config.mjs apps/docs/scripts/*.mjs apps/docs/src/content.config.ts apps/docs/src/styles/docs.css "apps/docs/src/content/docs/**/*.{md,mdx}" e2e/package.json
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @flanksource/clicky-ui lint && pnpm --filter kitchen-sink lint && pnpm --filter storybook lint && pnpm --filter e2e lint
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @flanksource/clicky-ui build:icons && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
